اعتمدت (form VIII)
# اِعْتَمَدْتُ (iʕtamadtu) /iʕ.ta.mad.tu/: first-person singular past active of اِعْتَمَدَ (iʕtamada)
# اِعْتَمَدْتَ (iʕtamadta) /iʕ.ta.mad.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِعْتَمَدَ (iʕtamada)
# اِعْتَمَدْتِ (iʕtamadti) /iʕ.ta.mad.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِعْتَمَدَ (iʕtamada)
# اِعْتَمَدَتْ (iʕtamadat) /iʕ.ta.ma.dat/: third-perso
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
